Definition: a Gebalite, or inhabitant of Gebal
BiblicalUsage: Giblîy means a Gebalite, an inhabitant of Gebal. It turns up twice, in Joshua and 1 Kings.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: Giblîy means a Gebalite, an inhabitant of Gebal, and I do not stretch it further.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
